SELECT pp.production_plan_id, pp.department_id, pp.item_id, pp.production_qty, pp.start_date, pp.due_date, pp.status, pp.created_by, pp.created_at, pp.updated_at,
i.item_code, i.item_name,
d.department_name,
u.user_name AS created_by_name
FROM production_plan pp
JOIN item i ON i.item_id = pp.item_id
JOIN department d ON d.department_id = pp.department_id
JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = pp.created_by
ORDER BY pp.production_plan_id DESC

SELECT pp.production_plan_id, pp.department_id, pp.item_id, pp.production_qty, pp.start_date, pp.due_date, pp.status, pp.created_by, pp.created_at, pp.updated_at,
i.item_code, i.item_name,
d.department_name,
u.user_name AS created_by_name
FROM production_plan pp
JOIN item i ON i.item_id = pp.item_id
JOIN department d ON d.department_id = pp.department_id
JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = pp.created_by
WHERE pp.production_plan_id = #{productionPlanId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO production_plan ( department_id, item_id, production_qty, start_date, due_date, status, created_by ) VALUES ( #{departmentId}, #{itemId}, #{productionQty}, #{startDate}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{createdBy} )
